caption: The first row of school desks on the left side of the scene has decreased in size from two desks to one. The yellow desktop at the front center of the classroom, placed on the floor between two desks, is no longer present.

A new tree with a dense canopy and thin branches has appeared on the left side of the road, near the corner of the building and in front of the seating area. The woman in a white shirt and black shorts, who was previously on the left side of the road crossing, is now positioned on the right side of the road.

A new wall-mounted light has appeared on the right side of the scene, positioned to the left of the yellow bicycle. The black trash can hanging on the wall on the right side of the yellow bicycle is present.

The wooden lounge chair on the left side of the scene has been moved to the right, closer to the bench. The red trash bin at the far end of the greenhouse on the right side of the green hose has appeared.
A blue sign with the word "Hashooh" has been newly added to the wall above the first bed on the right side of the scene.

A man with a black umbrella is no longer visible on the left side of the road, near the corner of the green building and the blue building. A person wearing a red shirt and blue pants appears at the traffic light on the right side of the road.
